Page 1:
A modification of the Shameless AU I have been posting recently. After spending quite some time to figure out exactly what she likes and with the boys having become comfortable with what they like to do, both solo and together, the result is her changing styles a bit. She is real chill, and very sexually active, with a bit of a sub streak.

Page 2:
Not much to say with this one. Gadget embracing her new gothic style and being a bit inviting, and teasing, in a sort of rougher way. Really lets you know what she likes.

Page 3:
One last thing with Gadget to cap it all off, this time just going with something nice and simple with one of the boys. I have always found it kind of refreshing and kinky to find a girl who can get off to just anal, and doing something a bit rougher in general was fun too.
